game.genre: 3D real-time strategy RPG with open-world exploration and factory building
game.description: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG set on Talos-II, where Endfield Industries fights to reclaim a hostile frontier world. As the Endministrator you lead squads of operators through real-time tactical combat and open exploration, while developing automated factory complexes with the AIC system to power the recovery effort. It pairs character-driven gacha collection and action combat with deep factory building and automation in the Arknights universe.

currencies.name: Oroberyl
currencies.note: Premium currency spent on headhunting pulls and shop purchases; the main event reward payout.

currencies.name: T-Creds
currencies.note: Standard currency used for operator and weapon progression, shop trades, and most in-game costs.

currencies.name: Mark of Perseverance
currencies.note: Event certificate earned from event missions and challenges, spent in certificate exchange shops.

currencies.name: Wuling Stock Bills
currencies.note: Production currency earned by submitting support goods in the AIC Support: Chubby Lung Attacks event.

currencies.name: Fruits of Altruism Certs
currencies.note: Event exchange currency from the Chubby Lung Attacks Goods Exchange, redeemable for Oroberyl and materials.
